propositions: Diagnostic artifacts for completion-verifier runaway were committed to impl-10ae-verifier-ctx branch but never landed on main, making ticket evidence unverifiable on main

Three diagnostic files (transcript markdown, transcript driver, matrix driver) are reusable, parameterizable tools for budget-anchoring measurement and should be landable without implementation changes from their source commit

Verifier runaway loop (tool-call repetition) still occurs on current main despite runaway guard catching it; loop clusters on test-infrastructure tickets with multi-file criterion references, suggesting context pre-selection root cause

Budget-anchoring matrix confirms verifier needs ~6 steps per criterion but receives flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 budget (~10x surplus) for 8-criterion tickets, causing redundant re-reading before guard triggers
